text:
devrel-anna: Heads-up — found a weird parity issue between the Python and Node SDKs for embeddings->rerank flow. Node helper batches return shape (N, D) but Python client sometimes returns nested singletons. Repro below.

maria.dev: Oof. Can you paste the minimal repro? Is this in the sample app or a customer report?

devrel-anna: Minimal repro is from the sample-app's rerank worker. Steps: create two queries, call embeddings.rerank with batch_size=2. Node response: [[0.3,0.2,...],[0.1,0.05,...]] (good). Python response: [[ [0.3,0.2,...] ], [ [0.1,0.05,...] ]] — extra nesting when you pass single-item lists into the helper.

samir: I saw something similar last week but pegged it to our retry/auth middleware — token refresh race can cause the JS SDK to rewrap responses after a 401->retry. Could be double-wrapping arrays on retry merge.

jordan: @samir do you have logs? which middleware layer would rewrite the payload? infra logs show the reranker returns consistent JSON. If token flow is doing a body transform, that would be bad.

samir: here's a small trace from local dev env:
```
[2026-02-15T16:12:02.123Z] Request POST /v1/embeddings.rerank body: { inputs: [ ... ] }
[2026-02-15T16:12:02.456Z] Response 401 - token expired
[2026-02-15T16:12:02.789Z] Token refreshed
[2026-02-15T16:12:03.010Z] Retried request - final response body: { results: [ { embedding: [[0.12,0.3,...]] } ] }
```
Notice the embedding field got an extra array level after retry.

maria.dev: That matches the customer note I had. They saw consistent shapes on first call, then odd shapes only after an auth retry (timed tests).

leo: Quick workaround in SDK: normalize embeddings with a small helper:
```
function normalizeEmbedding(e){
  while(Array.isArray(e) && e.length === 1) e = e[0];
  return e;
}
```
But that's gross and shouldn't be necessary.

devrel-anna: Also the Node SDK's batch helper automatically collates items into TypedArrays for speed. If the Python client returns Python lists of lists it won't be identical. This is more than just formatting — sample-app tests that expect exact JSON equality fail.

jordan: Can someone paste the exact call site in the sample-app? I want to see if the helper does any mutation on the request or response.

devrel-anna: snippet from sample-app (Node):
```
const batches = batcher.group(inputs, {size: 8});
const resp = await client.embeddings.rerank({items: batches[0]});
// resp.results -> array of {embedding: Float32Array}
```
Python snippet (from sample-app):
```
batches = batcher.group(inputs, size=8)
resp = client.embeddings.rerank(items=batches[0])
# resp["results"] -> embedding: [[0.1, 0.2, ...]]
```
So two things: (1) the Python SDK returns nested arrays for singletons, (2) Node returns TypedArrays.

samir: I think the extra nesting only surfaced when the retry code path re-serializes the response. Will open a quick PR to stop transformation on retry.

maria.dev: We should also add a doc note and a small conformance test in CI that compares normalized shapes between SDKs. DX onboarding failure is customers hitting sample app tests that differ by type shape.

leo: Filed a small PR suggestion in the sample-app to run a normalizer step after network responses. But we shouldn't ship that as permanent.

infra-bot: Deployment staged: sample-app fix candidate pushed to staging (deploy id: d-9876).

devrel-anna: Another subtle thing: the rerank response format differs for single vs multi-item queries. Some teams expect a flat list of scorings; others expect a per-item list-of-lists. Should we standardize to always emit per-input arrays (even for singletons) and document it?

jordan: Standardizing is fine but must be explicit in contract. I'd prefer stable typed responses (no TypedArray in API JSON) — SDKs can convert to TypedArray locally but JSON payload should be regular arrays to avoid parity diffs.

maria.dev: +1 on explicit contract. Action items: 1) eng-ml to stop response rewrap on retry (samir), 2) SDK teams to add a normalize helper and a conformance test (leo + jordan), 3) docs team to add an onboarding note and sample-app fix (me), 4) QA to add an e2e that forces a 401 and checks shapes.

samir: I created issue INF-2243, pinned logs and a tiny repro in the issue. Will send PR to stop the body transform on retry.

leo: I pushed a tiny JS helper and a unit test. Linking PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/sample-app/pulls/112

devrel-anna: Thanks everyone. If you see a customer red flag, ping me. I'll update the onboarding doc and add a small snippet: "If you see nested singletons in embeddings.rerank responses, normalize with flattening helper or update SDKs." 

maria.dev: marking this resolved for sample-app but keeping the bug open until eng-ml patch is in prod. :white_check_mark:
